photos.title: Towers on the Grove from above
photos.what: Towers on the Grove from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the tower stands on the oceanfront in the middle with a lazy river at its base; a white building stands to its east and a parking deck across the road to its north; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Towers on the Grove from above, on the oceanfront in Cherry Grove.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Towers on the Grove tower on the oceanfront in Cherry Grove, North Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the beach and the Atlantic Ocean to the southeast
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-17; the exact request is in source_request.

photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS). Labels by Chapter3 Realty.
